unblock_request.detail: Cannot integrate INTEGRATION-UNBLOCK-BFF-TEST-MIGRATION-CB07-MANAGEMENT-CONSOLE-READS-OPS-001-MISSIN-0E4591A750E9: repository `pantheon` has no explicit integration_path; live execution may not use its worker/source local_path as the merge checkout.

root_cause.summary: During candidate evaluation in scripts/git/auto_integrator.py, live integration execution (--execute) enforces require_dedicated_integration_path=True (line 3433). Candidate discovery sets dedicated_integration_path = bool(resolved_repo.get('integration_path')) (line 607). In the live supervisor runtime configuration at /home/chloe_ong_dev_cctech_support_com/pantheon-ci-deploy/runtime/live-supervisor-mainroot-config.json, coordination.repositories.pantheon contains only {'repo': 'ajoe734/pantheon'} and lacks an explicit integration_path entry. Consequently, dedicated_integration_path evaluated to False for PR #5909 (head 7a3c6d1b0c03e8fb4f2c6a1a5b6307bd0526d64e), triggering the fail-closed rejection at auto_integrator.py:2319-2324 with reason 'missing-dedicated-integration-path' and opening this secondary unblock task.
root_cause.configuration_source: The missing integration_path stems from the runtime replacement recorded in /home/chloe_ong_dev_cctech_support_com/pantheon-ci-deploy/coordination-root/.orchestrator/logs/promotion-20260918T010014Z.json, where promote_supervisor_runtime.py was invoked with repository_integration_roots: {}, omitting the --repository-integration-root pantheon=<path> argument. When check_config_drift.py is evaluated with expected integration paths, it flags repository_integration_drift (expected pantheon integration root present under /home/chloe_ong_dev_cctech_support_com/pantheon-ci-deploy/integration-runtimes/pantheon/f15be762ef373cd24707b89e5b9b286650b9a097, but live_integration_path=null in live-supervisor-mainroot-config.json).
root_cause.integrator_behavior: scripts/git/auto_integrator.py operated exactly as designed. Per docs/operations/auto-integrator.md § Safety Model and scripts/git/auto_integrator_contract.md, live execution strictly requires a dedicated, isolated checkout for merge operations (coordination.repositories.<id>.integration_path) to prevent destructive merges or race conditions against shared worker or coordination worktrees (such as coordination-root, where ai-status.json is actively mutated). By failing closed with 'missing-dedicated-integration-path', auto_integrator.py prevented unsafe merge attempts against unisolated paths.
root_cause.recursive_unblock_trigger: Because PR #5909 delivered the root-cause analysis for PR #5890 into repository 'pantheon' and was review-approved, auto-integrator attempted to merge PR #5909 in live mode. Because 'pantheon' still lacked a dedicated integration_path in the live supervisor configuration, auto-integrator rejected PR #5909 with the same 'missing-dedicated-integration-path' safety check and generated this unblock task.

The missing integration_path is an external deployment/runtime configuration omission on the host supervisor, not a defect in auto_integrator.py.
